title: Agentic Workspace Operating Decision
description: Derived internal decision composed from admitted AW authority surfaces. It emits exactly one primary action or one typed blocker.

kind.description: Schema discriminator for the composed operating decision.

producer_module.description: Canonical module that produced the operating decision.

producer_function.description: Canonical function that produced the operating decision.

decision_id.description: Stable identity derived from input revisions, action, blocker, and terminal state.

admitted_input_revision.description: Canonical revision of the complete admitted input set from which decision_id is derived.

status.description: Whether the composed decision exposes an action, a blocker, or no immediate action.

input_revisions.description: Revision or freshness identifiers supplied by specialist authority inputs.

canonical_decision_input_revision.description: Canonical revision of the typed action's current owner, context, authority, proof, mutation, evaluation, and executor inputs.

context_authority_coverage.description: Registry-derived coverage of context authority sources and ordinary consumers considered by the decision compiler.

context_authority_projection.description: Consumer-specific admitted context authorities and the typed repair operation when any required source is unavailable.

context_consequences.description: Stable one-per-finding operational consequences, ordered from highest to lowest current impact.

highest_impact_context_consequence.description: The first active or terminal context consequence projected for ordinary consumers, or an empty object.

context_effects.description: Enforced ordinary action, review, claim, closeout, repair, and durable-lifecycle effects compiled from context consequences.

kind.description: Schema discriminator for enforced context effects.

status.description: Whether any active context finding changes ordinary work.

review_gate.description: Owner-review gate and contributing finding identities.

action_narrowing.description: Constraint applied to the current primary action and claims.

blocked_claim_classes.description: Claims forbidden until the owning finding is disposed.

closeout_obligations.description: Finding dispositions required before broad closeout.

typed_repairs.description: Revision-bound repair operations supplied by specialist owners.

durable_dispositions.description: Stable routed or deferred owner destinations and re-entry triggers.

convergence_rule.description: Rule for deduplication, terminal lifecycle, and continuation convergence.

intent_feedback.description: Revision-bound applicable intent expectations, evidence evaluation, material findings, and quiet/rescope posture composed before the final decision.

current_work.description: Current-work identity admitted into the composed decision.

selected_owner.description: Selected owner identity admitted into the composed decision.

terminal_state.description: Terminal outcome state used for continuation or finalization claims.

primary_action.description: Exactly one typed primary action when status is actionable; empty otherwise.

action_identity.description: Typed operation identity and live input revision used for execution-safety comparison.

external_blocker.description: Exactly one typed blocker when status is blocked; empty otherwise.

blocked_claim_classes.description: Claim classes this decision does not authorize.

provenance.description: Specialist authority inputs and owners preserved for traceability.

replacement_map.description: Compatibility map from older overlapping fields to their derived or demoted source.

additionalProperties.description: Replacement, demotion, or derivation rule for one legacy field.

rule.description: Invariant explaining authority composition and non-inference boundaries.
